name: the-space-dots-read-in-dark
description: The Arc-style space dots in dark mode, with a non-default accent. The active space (sunsetOrange, not the default oceanBlue) shows its bare glyph in its own ink, with no chip behind it. A space at rest is a small dot in the bar's own ink at 30 percent, so it follows the backdrop rather than a fixed grey. The Overview and + marks are the widest slots. The sibling the-space-dots-read-in-light runs the same checks in light mode.

actions.note: GATE: the active space's own tab committed, so the sidebar and its dot bar exist
ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot
THE CONTROL: the run really is in dark mode

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.spacedots'); if (!b) return 'NOBAR'; const w = (s) => { const e = b.querySelector(s); return e ? Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().width) : 'none'; }; const rest = '.sdot:not(.active):not(.ovdot):not(.addws)'; return 'ov:' + w('.sdot.ovdot') + ' add:' + w('.sdot.addws') + ' active:' + w('.sdot.active') + ' rest:' + w(rest) + ' dot:' + w(rest + ' .d'); })()

(() => { const a = document.querySelector('.spacedots .sdot.active'); if (!a) return 'NOACTIVE'; const d = a.querySelector('.d'); const cs = getComputedStyle(d); const n = (s) => (String(s).match(/[0-9.]+/g) || []).slice(0, 3).join(','); const second = document.querySelector('.spacedots .sdot[data-space-index="1"]'); return [d.textContent, cs.backgroundColor, n(cs.color) === n(a.dataset.ink) ? 'inked' : 'color=' + cs.color + ' ink=' + a.dataset.ink, second && second.dataset.ink !== a.dataset.ink ? 'own-ink' : 'shared-ink'].join('|'); })()
actions.note: own-ink: the accent space's ink differs from the oceanBlue neighbour's, so the ink really follows the space colour

actions.expression: (() => { const d = document.querySelector('.spacedots .sdot:not(.active):not(.ovdot):not(.addws) .d'); if (!d) return 'NODOT'; const cs = getComputedStyle(d); const ink = cs.getPropertyValue('--atrium-ink').trim().split(/\s+/).map(Number); const scale = /^color\(/.test(cs.backgroundColor) ? 255 : 1; const bg = (cs.backgroundColor.match(/[0-9.]+/g) || []).map(Number).map((v, i) => i < 3 ? v * scale : v); const same = ink.length === 3 && ink.every((v, i) => Math.abs(v - bg[i]) <= 1); return (same ? 'follows-ink' : 'ink=' + ink.join(' ') + ' bg=' + cs.backgroundColor) + ' a=' + (bg[3] ?? 1).toFixed(2); })()
actions.note: the base rule mixes currentColor (the ink at .85) at 35 percent, so the alpha is .2975, and a mix can come back as color(srgb) on a 0-1 scale
DIAGNOSTIC: the bar's ink in this mode, read beside the capture
the visual record of the bar in dark mode

assertions.desc: THE CONTROL: the sidebar renders in dark mode
The end marks are the widest, and a space at rest is a 5px dot
The selected space shows its bare glyph in its own ink, with no chip
The grey is the bar's own ink at 30 percent
